new.curriculum_name: Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering

courses.course_description: Foundational course introducing students to the engineering profession, focusing on basic concepts and the role of engineers in society[cite: 41, 53].
Explores the nature of identity and the various factors that shape the self through interdisciplinary perspectives[cite: 44, 53].
Examines the nature and application of mathematics as a tool for understanding patterns and solving practical problems in contemporary life[cite: 44, 53].
Analyzes Philippine history through primary sources, fostering critical thinking about the nation's political and social development[cite: 44, 53].
Develops communicative competence and enhances skills in conveying messages effectively to diverse audiences in various contexts[cite: 44, 53].
Covers the concepts of functions, limits, continuity, and derivatives, with applications in physical and engineering sciences[cite: 41, 53].
Provides fundamental principles of chemistry, including atomic structure and chemical reactions, essential for engineering analysis[cite: 41, 53].
Focuses on developing the fundamental movement skills and physical literacy required for health and fitness[cite: 44, 53].
Aims to develop civic consciousness and defense preparedness by involving students in service-oriented activities[cite: 46, 53].
Explores the concepts of integration, its techniques, and applications in determining areas, volumes, and work[cite: 41, 54].
Introduces mechanics, heat, and thermodynamics, emphasizing the application of physical laws to engineering problems[cite: 41, 54].
Introduction to logic formulation and high-level programming to solve basic computational problems[cite: 41, 54].
Teaches technical drawing standards and orthographic projections necessary for engineering communication[cite: 41, 54].
Examines the complexities of globalization and its impact on international economic and political landscapes[cite: 44, 54].
Develops the ability to appreciate and analyze various art forms within their cultural and aesthetic contexts[cite: 44, 54].
Explores the interactions between scientific progress, technological innovations, and societal development[cite: 44, 54].
Continuation of NSTP 1, focusing on community-based project implementation and practical service applications[cite: 46, 54].
Provides instruction on various exercises and activities designed to maintain and improve physical fitness[cite: 44, 54].
Study of the life, works, and writings of Jose Rizal, emphasizing his role in the development of Filipino nationalism[cite: 44, 56].
Discussion of moral frameworks and ethical theories that guide professional responsibility and human conduct[cite: 44, 56].
Highlights essential biological principles focusing on cell structures, genetics, and ecological health for engineers[cite: 41, 56].
Focuses on methods for solving equations used to model dynamic physical engineering systems[cite: 41, 59].
Introduces probability and statistics applied to industrial engineering problems and data analysis[cite: 41, 59].
Provides an overview of micro and macroeconomics principles relevant to engineering decision-making[cite: 41, 59].
Teaches fundamental accounting principles and practices used in managing industrial organizations[cite: 41, 59].
Covers the management of industrial enterprises, including organizational structures and production management[cite: 41, 59].
Advanced programming concepts and logic formulation for solving complex computational engineering tasks[cite: 41].
Covers environmental principles and the impact of engineering solutions on sustainability and ecology[cite: 41].
Refines communication skills in Filipino tailored for professional and academic contexts[cite: 44].

courses.course_title: Menu of Dance, Sports, Martial Arts, etc.
courses.course_description: Provides a selection of physical activities including traditional games and recreational sports[cite: 44, 47].
Continuation of statistical methods focusing on hypothesis testing, regression, and analysis of variance[cite: 41].
Study of materials used in industry and the various manufacturing processes to transform them into products[cite: 41].
Higher mathematical methods such as transforms and matrices used in industrial engineering applications[cite: 41].
Focuses on analyzing and measuring work methods to improve productivity and establish labor standards[cite: 41].
Training in CAD software for creating digital representations of technical and engineering designs[cite: 41].
Financial assessment tools for evaluating the economic feasibility of engineering projects[cite: 41].
Study of forces and their effects on physical bodies at rest and in motion[cite: 41].
Advanced usage of the Filipino language in research across various engineering and technical fields[cite: 44].
Focuses on team-building and skill development through competitive group sports like Basketball and Volleyball[cite: 44, 47].
Focuses on the use of accounting information for internal management planning and control[cite: 41].
Introduction to deterministic models and optimization techniques for solving complex industrial problems[cite: 41].
Discusses quality standards, philosophies, and the implementation of management systems in organizations[cite: 41].
Explores the design of systems, tools, and environments to fit the capabilities and limitations of human users[cite: 43].
Specialized course in computer-integrated manufacturing and automation in production systems[cite: 43].
Covers workplace hazard identification and safety protocols for industrial environments[cite: 41].
Fundamental principles of energy conversion and the laws governing heat and work[cite: 41].
Exploration of the literary works and cultural diversity of the ASEAN region[cite: 44].
Deals with stochastic models, queuing theory, and simulation for industrial engineering optimization[cite: 41].
The design, operation, and control of production systems to efficiently produce goods and services[cite: 43].
Advanced ergonomics focusing on cognitive and organizational factors in system design[cite: 43].
Techniques for conducting feasibility studies, focusing on market and technical analysis[cite: 43].
Discusses professional ethical standards and values critical for engineering practice[cite: 43].
Covers basic electrical circuits and components necessary for industrial systems[cite: 41].
Statistical methods and systems for ensuring product and process quality in industry[cite: 43].
Focuses on financial and economic analysis for completing a full project feasibility report[cite: 43].
Study of Six Sigma methodologies for process improvement and defect reduction[cite: 43].
Explores the intersection of engineering innovation and entrepreneurship for business creation[cite: 41].
Immersive industrial internship providing real-world experience in various functional areas[cite: 43].
Teaches scientific research methodologies from problem definition to data collection[cite: 43].
The design and management of integrated supply chains for efficient material and information flow[cite: 43].
Analysis and design of information systems to support management decision-making[cite: 43].
Focuses on the design and management of complex systems throughout their life cycles[cite: 43].
Final design project demonstrating integration of IE knowledge to solve a real-world problem[cite: 43].
Preparation for professional practice through integrative activities and comprehensive assessment[cite: 43].
